name: Deficit Pushup
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Hold the weight up, then lower it slowly.
start_cue.hi: Weight upar pakdo, phir dheere neeche lao.

good.en: Good. You went down low enough.

fix.en: Lower your chest closer to the floor.
fix.hi: Chest ko floor ke aur paas lao.

below.en: Do not sink that low. Stop a fist above the floor.
below.hi: Itna neeche nahi. Floor se mutthi bhar upar ruko.

almost.en: Lower your chest closer to the floor.
almost.hi: Chest ko floor ke aur paas lao.

good.en: Good. Your back stayed in one line.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aapki back ek line mein rahi.

fix.en: Your hips are sagging or piking. Keep one straight line.
fix.hi: Hips gir rahe hain ya uthe hue hain. Ek seedhi line rakho.

almost.en: Your hips are sagging or piking. Keep one straight line.
almost.hi: Hips gir rahe hain ya uthe hue hain. Ek seedhi line rakho.

fix.en: Too fast. Lower yourself under control. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Neeche control se aao. 2 tak gino.

above.en: Very slow. Good control — keep moving smoothly.
above.hi: Bahut slow hai. Control achha hai, smooth chalte raho.

below.en: Too fast. Lower yourself under control. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Neeche control se aao. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.
